name: Sales Factory
summary: One agent that researches every signup and inbound lead, scores it against your ICP, drafts outreach and meeting briefs, and keeps your CRM clean. A person sends every message.

secrets.name: SALES_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.why: Signs the webhook your product and your forms call for a new signup or an inbound lead (Authorization: Bearer).

secrets.name: ATTIO_API_KEY
secrets.why: System of record Attio, when the workspace has no Attio connector.

secrets.name: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.why: System of record HubSpot (a private app token), when the workspace has no HubSpot connector.

secrets.name: SALESFORCE_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.why: System of record Salesforce, with SALESFORCE_INSTANCE_URL, when the workspace has no Salesforce connector.

secrets.name: SALESFORCE_INSTANCE_URL
secrets.why: System of record Salesforce: your instance URL, for example https://example.my.salesforce.com. Not a secret.

secrets.name: PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN
secrets.why: System of record Pipedrive, when the workspace has no Pipedrive connector.

secrets.name: GH_TOKEN
secrets.why: System of record json-file only: read and write the ledger branch of a private repository with gh.
